proof-statement-integrity.evidence: Two of the three manuscript sub-claims are now derived; the first is not encoded at all. (i) Well-definedness of lambda* -- the manuscript derives it by running the LP relaxation, taking the optimal vertex and rounding. Nothing in the Lean constructs the LP, its vertex, or the arg min. The old library encoding had it as the bare field 'E_lambda != 0', which is neither that argument nor a consequence of it; it is dropped rather than restated. Also unencoded: the boundary variety is an opaque predicate OnBoundary, so its definition as {q : exists lam1 != lam2, |y_lam1(q)| = |y_lam2(q)|} and its measure-zero property are absent and the manuscript's 'generically' is not formalised; and continuity of E(lambda*, .) is a hypothesis of the crossing result, which the manuscript does not establish either.
proof-statement-integrity.notes: Two defects fixed. FIRST, the lean.ref did not resolve to the declaration it names. Per AGENTS.md 0a resolution checks the sibling first, and this sibling exists -- so qou:QOU.BraidKnot.UnstableAtom.decay_channel resolved HERE, to a file declaring decay_channel_unique and no decay_channel. The sibling's own docstring meanwhile declared the library path canonical ('The substantive Lean encoding ... lives at the canonical library path'), which resolution makes unreachable. The sibling now declares decay_channel. SECOND, the library DecayChannelContext carried Z, N, q, PartitionIdx, lam_star, E_lambda, on_boundary, lam_alt, q_1, q_2 AND all three sub-claims as its own fields, with decay_channel returning the three claim fields as a triple; on_boundary := fun _ => True makes (ii) vacuous, q_1 := 1, q_2 := 0 makes (iii) vacuous, E_lambda := 1 discharges (i), so the binder assumed nothing. The library file is gutted (0 importers). GAINED: sub-claim (iii) is now PROVED rather than assumed -- 'stable at q1, unstable at q2 implies exists q* in [q1,q2] with E(lambda*,q*) = 0' is the intermediate value theorem, which is what the manuscript's own Connection-to-phase-boundary paragraph argues; phase_boundary_crossing derives it from ContinuousOn and a sign change. Sub-claim (ii) is derived from the LP-duality selection input by composing it with itself through lam_star. .md untouched, so all 42 needs-agent criteria on this block are pre-existing.
